notes: EAF oxidizing slag 10-20% cement replacement in concrete; strength, setting, electrical properties.

1 Scientific Literature.Title: Effects of Steelmaking Slag and Moisture on Electrical Properties of Concrete
1 Scientific Literature.Authors: Se-Hee Hong, Tian-Feng Yuan, Jin-Seok Choi, Young-Soo Yoon
1 Scientific Literature.Study_Objective: Evaluate setting, strength and electrical (resistivity, piezoresistivity, gauge factor) properties of concrete with 10-20% EAF oxidizing slag as binder, with/without gypsum, and the effect of moisture.
1 Scientific Literature.Abstract_or_Key_Finding: Slag delayed setting; compressive strength similar to control up to 15% replacement (~60 MPa at 28 d), SS20 ~27% lower. 2% gypsum (SS15G) restored early strength. Slag lowered resistivity and raised FCR and gauge factor; drying doubled resistivity; free CaO expansion under load cracked concrete and affected GF.

2 Feedstock Chemistry.Source/Origin: EAF oxidizing slag, Republic of Korea (~40% iron oxide)
